verdict.rationale: Concurrency and scaling are a fair axis for a voice-call platform, but nothing in the evidence documents concurrency limits, simultaneous-call caps, or self-serve capacity scaling. The pricing and enterprise items cover per-minute billing, SSO and RBAC, which are adjacent topics rather than concurrency.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging
